home_page__hero_description: Everything you need to build full-stack applications, from authentication and database access to internationalization.
home_page__integrations__description: TanStack Start works with most major cloud providers and JavaScript runtimes thanks to the Nitro Vite plugin and our Docker templates.
home_page__setup_link_description: Run the setup wizard, choose your stack, and deploy your app.
home_page__setup_cli_description: The wizard guides you through naming your app, installing dependencies, and setting up a database.
home_page__setup_cli_directory_prompt: Where should the project be created?
home_page__setup_stack_description: Pick split or combined Node apps, or Cloudflare Workers with PostgreSQL or D1.
home_page__setup_deploy_description: Deploy with Docker on Coolify or Dokploy, or use Wrangler for Cloudflare Workers.
home_page__cta_description: Explore the documentation to learn how everything works, or jump straight into the CLI to scaffold your next project and start building.
home_page__faq_description: What’s included, what you can customize, and where you can deploy.
home_page__faq_about_answer: It’s an MIT-licensed TypeScript starter that puts your web app, API, and shared packages in one repo.
home_page__faq_included_answer: TanStack Start handles the web app, Hono and oRPC handle the API, Drizzle handles database access, and Better Auth handles sign-in and sessions. The repo also includes guides for coding agents.
home_page__faq_start_question: How do I create a project?
home_page__faq_start_answer: Run npm create tsu-stack@next my-app. The CLI asks how you want to deploy and whether you want it to set up your local environment.
home_page__faq_styling_answer: Yes. The shared UI package contains the component source and theme styles. Edit them directly in your project.
home_page__faq_locales_answer: Yes. Add a locale and its messages in the i18n package. Paraglide handles translation messages and localized routes.
home_page__faq_deploy_answer: Choose separate or combined Node apps, or deploy to Cloudflare Workers with PostgreSQL or D1. The Node starters include Docker Compose files.

home_page__testimonial_frontend: I came for the landing page and stayed because the full stack was already figured out. Bookmarked!

home_page__testimonial_platform: Separate web and API deployments? Already sorted. My Docker containers can finally live in peace.
home_page__testimonial_maintainer: The sign-in flow worked on the first run. I almost opened an issue because I thought something was wrong.
